channel.title: StudentOS Changelog
channel.description: Plain-English updates to StudentOS — what changed and why it matters for studying.

item.title: v2.18.4 — Fix Legal Portal Buttons in Google Sites Sandbox & Homepage Privacy Trigger
item.description: Fixed legal portal buttons embedded in Google Sites iframes to use target="_blank" with safe navigation, mounted PrivacyModal on the logged-out landing page, and bypassed PWA cache for legal pages.

item.title: v2.18.3 — Standalone Terms of Service + Google Sites Legal Portal Template
item.description: A public Terms of Service page is now live at /terms with Socratic AI guardrails, academic integrity standards, MIT licensing terms, and a ready-to-use 2-button landing page for Google Sites.

item.title: v2.18.2 — Standalone Bilingual Privacy Policy + Google Verification URL
item.description: A dedicated, crawlable Privacy Policy page is now live at /privacy with live English/Vietnamese language switching, complete Google API Limited Use disclosures, AI processing transparency (Gemini and Groq), and one-click data deletion instructions.

item.title: v2.18.1 — Privacy Page You Can Actually Open + Pilot Counters
item.description: The Vietnamese privacy page now opens from the dashboard and landing page with a working delete-all, the landing page lists the 6 current permissions, the app counts missed deadlines per week anonymously for the pilot, and links point to the real site.

item.title: v2.18.0 — Schedule You Control + One Main Flow + AI Test Report
item.description: The AI planner shows every change before applying it, keeps 15 earlier versions with undo, respects locked and hand-edited sessions, understands Vietnamese reschedule sentences, and never invents a deadline; the app now opens on one main flow, and an AI test report covers 30 school emails, 10 schedule commands and 10 tutor requests.

item.title: v2.17.1 — AI Back Online: Current Gemini Model Chain
item.description: Google retired the Gemini models StudentOS requested, so every AI feature had been silently falling back; all routes now share one chain led by the gemini-flash-latest alias, with a health probe that shows which model answered.

item.title: v2.17.0 — Trust Layer: Confirm Before Save, Review Box, 13 to 6 Permissions
item.description: AI-found assignments wait for a confirm card with the exact source sentence and an open-original link, no deadline is ever invented, skipped or uncertain emails stay in an "AI chưa đọc được" review box, Classroom announcements are read, and Google permissions drop from 13 to 6 with a Vietnamese privacy page for students and parents.

item.title: v2.16.0 — 100 Antigravity CLI UI/UX Improvements + Two-Tier Model Selector + Theme Engine
item.description: 100 tangible UI/UX improvements for Antigravity CLI vibe coding including a two-tier model selector (/model), visual quota dashboard (/quota) with solid blocks and multi-day countdowns, in-terminal Kanban board (/todo), workspace status HUD (/status), and 5 developer color palettes (/theme).

item.title: v2.15.0 — AI Planner Day View + Editable Times + Linked Sources
item.description: AI Planner shows one roomy day at a time with editable block times and a linked Tracker, Canvas, Classroom, Gmail and Moodle source list; dark-mode text safety net and Flagship wording removed.

item.title: v2.14.0 — Paper & Coal Theme + Semantic Palette
item.description: New Paper light (#F5F0E6) and Coal dark (#201D18) theme with ember-orange accent, ink/cream text, rebalanced borders, and new semantic colors (gold, sage, clay, amber, slate).

item.title: v2.13.0 — AI Planner All-Source Upgrade + Gmail-Native Inbox + Judge Hero
item.description: AI Planner fuses Tracker, Canvas, Classroom, Gmail, Moodle, 7-day Calendar and timetable with a 3.5-flash to 3.0-flash to Groq chain; Gmail trusts native Spam/Promo/Social labels with zero keywords; Dashboard hero, Top-8 first slot and pinned sidebar put it first.

item.title: v2.12.0 — Homework Sorter Metrics + Classifier Lab Experiment
item.description: Homework Sorter gains honest on-device metrics (holdout accuracy, confusion matrix, top-word reasons) and a new Classifier Lab tab compares zero-shot baseline vs 3-example few-shot on your own school messages with a side-by-side scoreboard.

item.title: v2.11.0 — Study Tools Wave + AI Planner + Safer Sync & Keys
item.description: Searchable PhET library with 29 sims, official GeoGebra embeds, local whiteboard and offline Python, strict embed allowlist, Gemini 2.5-flash keys with edit and expiry, Google auto-connect, named Canvas errors, formal Dossier, VI/EN contrast fixes, Gantt scan-all with preview, flashcard session limits, focus music, PDF fallback, Notion ZIP/CSV export, AI Planner, sanitized studio embeds, silent-empty Canvas fix, and a unified keys manager.

item.title: v2.10.0 — Warm Linen Theme + Buttery Motion
item.description: New warm linen palette (#F8F6F0 canvas, #F1ECE1 sidebar, white cards, #E05D38 buttons) with smoother hovers, page transitions, and button shine across the app.

item.title: v2.9.8 — Warm Cream Theme, Final Tuning + Motion Polish
item.description: Eight tuning passes settle the warm cream canvas, deeper sidebar, softer dark mode and livelier homepage with cascading entrances and tactile buttons.

item.title: v2.8.4 — Warmer Look: No Grey Wash, Lighter Sidebar
item.description: Dashboard drops the grey wash for warm cream and the sidebar turns soft light orange with dark readable text.

item.title: v2.8.3 — Canvas Production Fix: Sync Works on Vercel + Single Error Message
item.description: Canvas /api routes now reach the serverless router on the live site so pasted keys actually sync, proxy error details are surfaced, and the banner never doubles the retry hint.

item.title: v2.8.2 — Canvas Save & Sync Fix: New Credentials Actually Sync
item.description: Pressing Save & Sync in Canvas now syncs with the credentials you just entered instead of silently loading nothing with no error.

item.title: v2.8.1 — Canvas Sync Fix: Honest Errors When the Server API Is Down
item.description: Canvas sync now detects a broken deployment (server API returning pages instead of JSON) and says so plainly, instead of blaming your token or feed link; bare vite dev proxies /api to the app server.

item.title: v2.8.0 — Math That Renders: KaTeX Formulas in Every AI Answer
item.description: Math formulas in Study Coach, Feynman, quizzes, PhotoMath and STEM Lab now render as real equations with KaTeX, theme-matched and Vietnamese-safe.

item.title: v2.7.0 — Ember Palette, VI/EN Toggle, Calmer Toolbars & Honest Canvas
item.description: Official Ember canvas/border/accent palette everywhere, Vietnamese-English toggle with auto-detect, decluttered Tracker toolbar with Filters panel and Smart Add AI Rank, single-banner Canvas errors that keep cached assignments, and a multi-section homepage with Features, How-it-works, FAQ and Privacy.

item.title: v2.6.1 — True Palette, Point-At-You Tour & Honest Canvas Errors
item.description: Strict Warm Cream/Charcoal/Terracotta palette on every screen, spotlight tour that points at real buttons and auto-moves tabs, Canvas expired-feed and bad-token errors with fixes, and no more collapsed same-name assignments.

item.title: v2.6.0 — Everyday Polish: deadlines, focus & search feel instant
item.description: Tracker urgency badges and relative due dates, dashboard countdowns, timetable now-line, calmer Pomodoro, mood check-in, faster search with math copy and recents, Gmail unread badges, Drive sorting, CSV export, habits streaks and one-click citation copy.

item.title: v2.5.1 — True Two-Mode Theme, Calmer Home & Fixed App Icons
item.description: Exactly two modes: Warm Cream light and Dark Charcoal dark with terracotta accent. Simpler home, cleaner sidebar, every app icon unique.

item.title: v2.5.0 — Division A Kit: Home Fix, NASA Repair, AI Labs & Dossier
item.description: Getting-started card below Today Plan, NASA Image of the Day with retry, offline Train My Model Lab, Few-Shot Lab and Competition Dossier with PDF export.

item.title: v2.4.2 — Fixed: Google Sign-In That Would Not Finish
item.description: Clear sign-in errors with fixes, redirect sign-in for blocked popups, welcome-back sync, one-tap connection check.

item.title: v2.4.1 — Fixed: Blank Canvas Page & Google Sign-In Going Stale
item.description: One bad assignment row can no longer blank the Canvas page. Clear error with retry, permanent Google connection, cached data kept on failed sync.

item.title: v2.4.0 — Smarter studying: auto-scheduler, grade forecaster, voice + 15 new tools
item.description: One-tap focus planner, GPA what-if simulator, exam countdowns, teacher follow-ups, voice dictation, offline trash + history, and new workspaces (jobs, budget, code runner, resume).
